name: Kawasaki KZ305 / GPz305
engine: 306 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs
intro: Kawasaki's small twin of the 80s. Some years used a toothed belt instead of a chain.

K: Check whether yours has a chain or a belt final drive. A belt needs the right tension and no oil on it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
